name: Arr Profile Switcher
overview: Radarr/Sonarr quality-profile switcher for Jellyfin Web.
description: Profile-switch menu item on the item detail page and three-dot menu, scoped to movies and series. Options are admin-curated per Radarr/Sonarr instance; switching resolves the item, applies the profile, and triggers a search server-side. API keys stay server-side.
changelog: 1.0.0.0 - Admin-curated profile-option mapping. GET /ArrProfileSwitcher/Status, POST /ArrProfileSwitcher/Upgrade. File Transformation client-script injection. Per-user item-visibility check on Status/Upgrade, atomic upgrade-cooldown, safe parsing of Radarr/Sonarr responses, HTTP client timeout, no hardcoded Radarr/Sonarr URL defaults. TV seasons are now also switchable (resolves to the parent series, sharing its cooldown), not just the series itself. Fixed the detail-page picker button going stale (wrong item, or an unrefreshed label) after Jellyfin's SPA restores a cached page instance or after a same-item switch; full profile names no longer get truncated under the button's icon.
